summary: Umbrella created at the user request so a SEPARATE session can be dispatched on the engine-bump tooling while this session stays on LTX and H3. It exists because MPI-457 and MPI-467 collide: 457 already claims a repo-side bump SKILL with an empirical floor check, 467 claims an engine-bump PLAYBOOK with a smoke gate, and two cold agents would write the same file. brief.md fixes the ownership split (457 = mechanic, 467 = guard), the build order, and the machine constraints - one GPU, the app engine owns 48188, the bench on 8188 is the user, and LTX is UNRUNNABLE locally until MPI-466 lands because the fp8 weights were deleted and the 41GB bf16 was never on the drive.

Umbrella owned by this session. MPI-467 (the GUARD) starts now; MPI-457 (the MECHANIC - in-place /engine/upgrade + the repo-side bump skill) deliberately stays in todo, on the umbrella build order: the playbook is the file both cards write into, so its headings get fixed before the mechanic lands. Machine constraints in brief.md re-checked and still hold - node_lock.json stays READ-only here, and the LTX raw template is another session's dirty file.

MPI-468 SPLIT CHANGED, recorded on both cards as the umbrella brief requires. The bump SKILL now EXISTS as /mpi-bump-engine, created under MPI-467 because routing was the gap the user hit: a cold agent told "test all the models" had no path to the playbook and would have grabbed /mpi-bump-local-comfy, which is BENCH-only. It follows the repo pattern (/mpi-add-model enforces add-model/, /mpi-add-flow enforces add-flow/). MPI-457 must EXTEND that skill with the in-place mechanic - git fetch --tags + checkout the pinned sha + pip only the changed core packages + restamp .mpi_engine_version - and the gate-5 empirical class_type check. It must NOT create a second bump skill: one skill, one playbook. That collision is the whole reason MPI-468 exists.

Umbrella stays in doing. Child MPI-467 shipped to validating (playbook + runner + enforced release gate + /mpi-bump-engine). Child MPI-457 untouched in todo - it now EXTENDS /mpi-bump-engine with the in-place mechanic rather than creating a second skill. Next session picks up THIS id.
